blendVariants.label: Natural
blendVariants.title: Double Ligero Chiselito Natural
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Black pepper, leather, cedar, toast and dense tobacco sweetness drive the Natural Chiselito, with the Ecuadorian Sumatra sun-grown wrapper putting more dry spice and aromatic wood around the ligero-heavy Dominican core. The compact chisel shape keeps the smoke concentrated and forceful, with a firm savoury centre and a long pepper-and-cedar finish.
blendVariants.noteHtml: Untasted. CigarWorld lists the exact 5″ × 44 Natural single at A$34.37, but it is currently unavailable.
